0022600190.text: The Hawks (6-4) are first in the Southeast and fourth in the East, have won three straight, and are 2-2 at home, while the Nets (2-6) are 13th in the East, five games back in the Atlantic, and riding a one-game win streak. Atlanta is without Jalen Johnson (ankle), Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise). The Hawks won the 2025-26 season series 4-0 and beat the Nets 141-107 in Brooklyn in their last meeting on April 3, and the teams have not met yet this season.
